Kit summary

Tactical ThrowBasic
Deals 220% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Burn] for 2 turns. Afterward, increases self Turn Meter by 10%.
Grenade BombardingActive
Consumes 1 layer of [Grenade] and removes 1 layer of a random buff from all enemies. Afterward, deals 80% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 100% chance to reduce all enemies' Effect RES by 50% for 2 turns. This DMG is considered as [Burn] DMG. Popper can only cast this skill when he has [Grenade].
Tactical RearmamentPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Popper gains 2 layers of [Grenade] and increases self Turn Meter by 20% at the beginning of each wave. If Popper has the highest SPD among allies, he will gain an extra 1 layer of [Grenade] and additionally increase self Turn Meter by 10%. Popper gains 1 layer of [Battle Supply] at the end of allies' turn. He will consume all 12 layers of [Battle Supply] to gain 1 layer of [Grenade], up to 6 layers.
Surprise Grenade Lv.1Consumes all layers of [Grenade] when Popper dies, dealing 320% ATK DMG to all enemies (each layer consumed will increase ATK DMG by 80%) and extra 320% ATK Detonation DMG (each layer consumed will increase ATK DMG by 80%), with a 70% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn.
Surprise Grenade Lv.2Popper gains 10 layers of [Battle Supply] at the beginning of each wave. He will cleanse all debuffs from self and act for 1 turn immediately when consuming [Battle Supply] to gain [Grenade].
Trump CardActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 2 stages of 80% ATK DMG each to all enemies. This DMG is considered as [Burn] DMG. The first stage has a 70% chance to reduce targets' DEF by 60% for 2 turns. The second stage has a 70% chance to reduce targets' Tenacity by 60% for 2 turns.
Surprise Grenade Lv.3Each stage of DMG dealt by Trump Card also reduces targets' Turn Meter by 12%.
